notes.gunnuma: For mu-/gu- nouns: omutwe gunuma, my head hurts.
notes.lunnuma: For lu- nouns: olubuto lunuma, my stomach hurts.

guidebook.intro: Knowing how to say what hurts is useful anywhere. These words also bring back the noun classes from Unit 2.

tips.title: “It hurts me” agrees too
body: The body part decides the start of the verb. **Omutwe** and **omukono** take **gu-**: **gunuma**. **Olubuto** takes **lu-**: **lunuma**. **Okugulu** (leg) takes **ku-**: **kunuma**.

culture.title: Visiting the sick
body: When someone is ill, friends and family visit, bring food and wish them **Wona mangu**. A short visit matters more than a long one.
